system.description: Starting Move. When you burn a sacrifice and stare deeply into the flames, ask the GM one question about your sacrifice or something associated with it (owners, loved ones, history, etc.) and roll+CHA.

success.label: Success!
success.value: You see a clear and detailed vision in the flames that answers your question and related follow-up questions.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: You see a brief vision in the flames that answers your question vaguely.
